message.content:
Build a complete Feature Requests page for the Zip Code Checker Shopify app. This is an in-app feature request/feedback board where shop owners can suggest and vote on features.

## What to build

### 1. Prisma Schema — Add two new models to `prisma/schema.prisma`:

```prisma
model FeatureRequest {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  title       String
  description String
  category    String   @default("General")
  status      String   @default("under_review") // under_review, planned, in_progress, done, shipped
  shop        String   // who submitted it
  votesCount  Int      @default(0) // denormalized vote count for sorting
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())
  updatedAt   DateTime @updatedAt
  votes       FeatureVote[]

  @@index([status])
  @@index([votesCount])
}

model FeatureVote {
  id               String         @id @default(cuid())
  featureRequestId String
  shop             String
  createdAt        DateTime       @default(now())
  featureRequest   FeatureRequest @relation(fields: [featureRequestId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([featureRequestId, shop])
  @@index([shop])
}
```

### 2. Run the migration
After updating schema.prisma, run: `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-feature-requests`

### 3. Create route `app/routes/app.feature-requests.tsx`

This should follow all existing patterns from CLAUDE.md. Here's the full spec:

**Loader:**
- `authenticate.admin(request)` 
- Fetch all FeatureRequests with vote count
- Check which ones the current shop has voted for
- Return features, shop name, stats

**Action (intents):**
- `submit` — create a new FeatureRequest (title, description, category required)
- `vote` — toggle vote on a feature request (upvote if not voted, remove vote if already voted). Update the denormalized votesCount.
- `delete` — delete own feature request (only if shop matches)

**Component UI (Polaris v13 ONLY):**

The page should look premium and polished like the screenshot reference:

1. **Page header**: Title "Feature Requests", subtitle "Vote on features or suggest new ones. We review every request and ship based on community votes."
   - backAction to /app
   - primaryAction: "Suggest a Feature" button that opens a modal

2. **Stats bar** (like waitlist page): 
   - Total requests count
   - Under Review count  
   - Planned count
   - In Progress count
   - Done/Shipped count

3. **Filter tabs** using Polaris `Tabs` component:
   - All, Under Review, Planned, In Progress, Done
   - Each tab shows count badge

4. **Sort dropdown**: "Most Voted" (default), "Newest", "Oldest"

5. **Feature request cards** — each card shows:
   - Vote button on the left (upvote arrow + count). If the current shop has voted, show it as active/primary tone
   - Title (bold)
   - Description (truncated to 2 lines with "View details" link)
   - Status badge (color-coded: under_review=attention, planned=info, in_progress=warning, done=success)
   - Category badge
   - Date submitted
   - If the current shop submitted it, show a delete button

6. **Suggest a Feature modal:**
   - Title (TextField, required)
   - Description (TextField multiline, required)  
   - Category (Select: General, UI & Design, Data & Export, API & Integration, Performance, Billing)
   - Submit button

7. **Empty state** when no features match filter

8. **Pagination** — 10 items per page

**Important implementation details:**
- Use `useFetcher` for all actions (vote, submit, delete)
- Show toast on success actions
- The vote button should be optimistic — update UI immediately before server responds
- Use proper Polaris components: Page, Layout, Card, BlockStack, InlineStack, Text, Button, Badge, Tabs, Select, TextField, Modal, EmptyState, Box, Divider, Icon, Banner, Tooltip
- Import icons from @shopify/polaris-icons as needed
- Add loading states
- Handle errors with Banner inside modal
- Use `useAppBridge` for toasts

### 4. Update navigation in `app/routes/app.tsx`
Add a nav link for Feature Requests between "Help & Support" and before the closing tag:
```
<s-link href="/app/feature-requests">Feature Requests</s-link>
```

### 5. Update the help page link
In `app/routes/app.help.tsx`, change the Feature Requests button from external URL to internal navigation:
```tsx
<Button
  url="/app/feature-requests"
>
  Feature Requests
</Button>
```
Remove the `external` prop.

### 6. Run typecheck
After everything is done, run `npm run typecheck` and fix ALL errors.

## Code quality requirements:
- Follow ALL patterns from CLAUDE.md
- TypeScript everywhere, no `any` types
- Error handling on every async operation
- Only Polaris v13 components
- Match the exact patterns from existing routes like app.waitlist.tsx

## Reference files to read first:
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/CLAUDE.md`
- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/prisma/schema.prisma`

- `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/db.server.ts`

Build everything and make sure typecheck passes.

---

## What was built

### Files modified

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/prisma/schema.prisma`**
Added two new models at the bottom: `FeatureRequest` and `FeatureVote` with proper indexes, unique constraints, and a cascade-delete relation.

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.tsx`**
Added `<s-link href="/app/feature-requests">Feature Requests</s-link>` to the nav after Help & Support.

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.help.tsx`**
Changed the Feature Requests button from `url="https://feedback.zipcodechecker.app" external` to `url="/app/feature-requests"` (internal navigation, no `external` prop).

### Files created

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/prisma/migrations/20260319000000_add_feature_requests/migration.sql`**
Raw SQL migration ready to apply against the PostgreSQL database. The database was unreachable during this session (Railway proxy timeout), so the migration SQL is staged and ready. Run `npx prisma migrate deploy` once the DB is accessible, or `npx prisma migrate dev --name add-feature-requests` in local dev.

**`/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Shopify App/Zip-Code/app/routes/app.feature-requests.tsx`**
Full feature requests page with:
- Loader: fetches all `FeatureRequest` rows + which ones the current shop has voted for, computes 5 stat counts
- Action: three intents — `submit` (create new request), `vote` (toggle upvote with denormalized count update), `delete` (owner-only delete)
- Stats bar (5 tiles matching the waitlist page pattern)
- Polaris `Tabs` for filter (All / Under Review / Planned / In Progress / Done) with live counts
- Sort dropdown (Most Voted / Newest / Oldest)
- Feature cards with vote button (primary tone when voted), status badge (color-coded), category badge, truncated description with "View details" toggle, delete button for own requests
- "Suggest a Feature" modal with title + description + category, character count, error Banner
- Optimistic voting — UI updates immediately before server response, syncs back on completion
- Per-card loading state tracked via `useRef` + local state (avoids the `fetcher.formData` typed-as-`never` issue)
- Pagination (10 per page)
- `EmptyState` for zero results
- `useAppBridge` toasts for all mutations
- `ErrorBoundary` + `headers` exports matching every other route

### DB schema changes to note
- New model `FeatureRequest`: `id`, `title`, `description`, `category`, `status`, `shop`, `votesCount`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`
- New model `FeatureVote`: `id`, `featureRequestId`, `shop`, `createdAt`; unique constraint on `(featureRequestId, shop)` prevents double-voting

### Testing steps
1. Apply the migration once the DB is reachable: `npx prisma migrate deploy`
2. Open the app — "Feature Requests" appears in the nav after Help & Support
3. Click "Suggest a Feature", fill in the form, submit — toast confirms submission
4. The new request appears in the list under "Under Review" with 0 votes
5. Click the vote button — it turns primary, count increments immediately (optimistic), syncs from server
6. Click again to remove the vote
7. The submitting shop sees a "Delete" button on their own requests
8. Tab filters and sort dropdown filter/sort the list correctly
9. The Feature Requests button on the Help & Support page navigates internally (no new tab)
